name: Ooshiro Yayoi
source:
She is swept away by the protagonist, who tends to be captivated by her mother's charms. She uses her own body to realize his fantasies.

She loves her mother but doesn't want to lose to her. She is straightforward in her thinking and her earnestness can sometimes make her go berserk.
　
She is a virgin.

[From [url=http://kikenn.sakura.ne.jp/KuroyokamI/topindexPL0002.htm]official site[/url]]
